description: .Net GPU compute for the browser and desktop. Write once, run on WebGPU, WebGL, Wasm, CUDA, OpenCL, and CPU.
releaseNotes: v4.9.12: bundles forks 2.0.10. Generic-math f16 kernels: `NumericConvert.ToFloat32<T>`/`ToFloat64<T>` are transpilable generic converts (frontend convert-intrinsic, monomorphized to the per-type GPU cast) so a generic kernel can widen a generic numeric weight (`where TW : INumber<TW>`, TW = float|Half) to float/double for fp32/fp64 accumulation — the C# `float.CreateTruncating<T>` fails to lower (inspects typeof). ILGPU.Half now implements INumber<Half> / ISignedNumber<Half> (C# 11 generic math). A generic-math kernel (where T : INumber<T>) over Half now binds to Half's transpilable FP32 [MathIntrinsic] operators on all 6 backends, instead of being forced onto System.Half whose INumber members lower to a BitCast that fails codegen. Also fixes a latent bug: Half.One was new Half(0x1) == epsilon, not 1.0 == 0x3C00 — which made (Half)true produce epsilon in the bool->Half conversion (Convert.cs). Verified: generic-math Half kernel 9/9 backends + full sweep 3137 pass / 0 fail. v4.9.12-local.7 (local dev): perf — shader-RESOLUTION cache (WebGPUBackend.EnableShaderResolveCache, default ON) finishes eliminating per-dispatch O(WGSL) work. Caches the resolved compute shader per (compiled-kernel identity + dispatch-config signature: auto-grouped userDim, explicit GroupDim, dynamic-shared element count/size), so a re-dispatch of the same kernel at the same config skips GetOrCreateComputeShader and its O(WGSL-length) content HASH (the last O(WGSL) cost left after local.6). The key captures every resolution input — complete by construction (a hit returns the exact shader the resolve would produce); holds references to shaders the native accelerator's cache already owns (no GPU resources, no eviction). WebGPUAccelerator.ShaderResolveCacheHits/Misses telemetry + ClearShaderResolveCache(). Discrimination guard ShaderResolveCache_HitsAndDiscriminatesByDispatchSize (small-then-large auto-grouped dispatch catches a userDim-missing key). v4.9.12-local.6 (local dev): perf — eliminate per-dispatch O(WGSL) work in the WebGPU dispatch path (helps every high-dispatch-rate kernel: rendering loops, sims, fixed-shape ML decode). (1) WebGPUCompiledKernel.CompiledWorkgroupSize memoizes the @workgroup_size parsed ONCE from the WGSL, so the per-dispatch workgroup-patch compare and the dispatch-log record no longer run a full-WGSL regex (the regex now fires only on the rare KernelSpecialization-mismatch patch path). (2) The shader cache key is now a composite (wgsl, constants) tuple instead of a $"{wgsl}\n__CONSTANTS__:..." concatenation — no full-WGSL-length string allocation per dispatch. Behavior-preserving (identical workgroup-size parse; equivalent cache semantics). v4.9.12-local.5 (local dev): + per-dispatch CPU-PROLOGUE phase profiling under the same EnableDispatchProfiling flag — splits the .NET build/submit residual (the (forward − GPU-wait − readback) slice) into directly-measured phases: ProfileCpuShaderResolveMs (override-constant build + workgroup regex + shader lookup, O(WGSL)), ProfileCpuArgBuildMs (arg expand + reflection + scalar pack + bind-group entries + aliasing check), ProfileCpuBindGroupMs (CreateBindGroup + workgroup math), ProfileCpuEncodeMs (pass encode + dispatch-record), ProfileCpuDispatchCount. ResetDispatchProfiling zeros them. Measured (synthetic fixed-shape repeat): shaderResolve only ~4-8% (NOT the bottleneck), argBuild ~31-41%, bindGroup ~30%, encode ~26-30%. Additive, diagnostic, default OFF. v4.9.12-local.4 (local dev): + GPU-wait dispatch profiling now also times the GPU->CPU readback MapAsync(Read) surface (WebGPUBackend.ProfileReadbackWaitMs / ProfileReadbackWaitCount) - the OTHER place a step's GPU-wait hides (logits/shape readbacks queued behind prior work read ~0 in ProfileSyncWaitMs). Both surfaces now captured under the same EnableDispatchProfiling flag so a step's GPU-wait sums to the total instead of forcing a manual stitch of the consumer's readback timing. ResetDispatchProfiling zeros all four counters. Additive, diagnostic, default OFF - sync fields unchanged. v4.9.12-local.3 (local dev): + recur-only bind-group cache eviction - a (pipeline + buffer-bindings) signature is cached only on its 2nd sighting, so one-shot dispatches never park a live GPUBindGroup (bounds the cache; fixes the unbounded-growth / WebGPU framework-error mode at <100% hit rate) + BindGroupCacheEntryCount telemetry. v4.9.12-local.2 (local dev): + gated GPU-wait dispatch profiling (WebGPUBackend.EnableDispatchProfiling / ProfileSyncWaitMs / ProfileSyncWaitCount / ResetDispatchProfiling) - splits a step's wall-time into GPU-wait (OnSubmittedWorkDone) vs .NET-side build to find where the per-step ML-decode floor actually goes. Diagnostic, default OFF. v4.9.12-local.1 (local dev): opt-in WebGPU bind-group cache - WebGPUBackend.EnableBindGroupCaching + WebGPUAccelerator.ClearBindGroupCache()/BindGroupCacheHits/BindGroupCacheMisses; reuses GPUBindGroups across identical-signature (fixed-shape decode) dispatches to cut the per-step GPU floor, keyed on buffer object identity. Default OFF. v4.9.11: Math.Clamp now works in kernels on all 6 backends (frontend remap to throw-free IntrinsicMath.Clamp); async browser parity (overridable SynchronizeAsync/CopyToCPUAsync core virtuals + real ReduceAsync drain), MemSetToZeroAsync, Wasm TensorView+Half struct-param dispatch, WebGL nested-struct hoisted init, opt-in Wasm host-buffer race detector. Bundles forks 2.0.8.
